main.description: Gets an actor's indexed organization sidecar, associated profile and location by DID. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID of the actor to look up.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID is invalid or an unsupported parameter was supplied.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed organization sidecar exists for this DID.

errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed organization sidecar, associated profile or location could not be queried.

locationRecordView.description: Indexed app.certified.location record view preserving the full record exactly as getLocation returns it, but without the hydrated author; indexedAt may be null when the index has no timestamp.

organizationActorView.description: Actor with an indexed organization sidecar, nullable profile view and nullable location view.

location.description: The organization's location record, as stored (blobs are not resolved). Only returned by getOrganization, getOrganizations, listOrganizations and searchOrganizations. Null if there is no location or it is not indexed. Matched by URI, so it may be a newer version than organization.record.location.cid.
